channel.title: AI Threat Watch wire
channel.description: AI security headlines from vetted sources, refreshed every 30 minutes.

item.title: La société de cybersécurité Wiz affirme avoir utilisé des outils d'intelligence artificielle pour découvrir un
item.description: Boursorama: Wiz says it used AI tools to discover a critical flaw; the headline is truncated and gives no sign of exploitation.

item.title: 调查显示黑客利用Grok等AI对金融机构发起自动化攻击
item.description: 手机新浪网: A survey reports hackers used AI such as Grok to launch automated attacks on financial institutions, apparently linked to the known AI banking breach.

item.title: ClickFix has never been bigger, and AI tools are its most convincing lure yet
item.description: BleepingComputer: Push Security says ClickFix attacks are surging, using fake AI installers, poisoned search results and trusted chatbot platforms as lures.

item.title: AI Guardrails Aren’t Stopping Criminal Hackers
item.description: WIRED Security: WIRED reports criminal hackers worldwide are using agentic AI and manipulating tools like Claude to carry out attacks.

item.title: Exclusive | AI Just Found A Bug That Puts Up to 70% of the World’s Websites at Risk
item.description: WSJ: WSJ reports an AI tool found a PHP bug that could put up to 70% of websites at risk; no exploitation is reported.

item.title: AI工具诱饵越来越逼真，ClickFix攻击创下新高
item.description: Mezha.net: Report says ClickFix attacks hit record levels as realistic AI-tool lures trick users into running malware.

item.title: В Приморском крае полиция пресекла онлайн-аферу с использованием мошенниками технологии дипфейк
item.description: МВД Медиа: Police in Russia's Primorsky Krai stopped an online scam in which fraudsters used deepfake technology.

item.title: “Next Exploit Opportunities”: How a Threat Actor Used AI to Help Plan and Execute Multiple Types of Cybercrime Activities
item.description: Unit 42: Unit 42 details a threat actor who bypassed AI safety controls to plan credential theft, VoIP fraud and database exfiltration.

item.title: Symantec Uncovers AI Agent Hijacking Models for Autonomous Cyber-Attacks
item.description: Infosecurity Magazine: Symantec researchers report an AI agent built to run a full cyber-attack without human intervention.

item.title: LiteLLM Compromised, Steals Credentials
item.description: Wiz Research: Malicious LiteLLM 1.107.0 was uploaded to PyPI and Docker on Oct 21 with a credential stealer and dormant C2.

item.title: PHP2Shell: AI uncovers critical RCE vulnerabilities affecting 70% of the Internet
item.description: Wiz Research: Wiz says AI uncovered critical RCE and memory disclosure flaws in the PHP engine, which it says affect 70% of the web.

item.title: 華語黑客約花5000美元 用AI攻破上百網站
item.description: 大紀元: A Chinese-speaking hacker reportedly used AI to break into 100+ websites for about $5,000, already tracked.

item.title: OpenAI Faces Wave of Lawsuits Across the United States
item.description: www.journaldunet.com: Report says OpenAI faces a wave of lawsuits across the United States, with no specific case in the headline.

item.title: ИИ самостоятельно взломал сайты 100+ компаний: одна атака обошлась в 50 долларов
item.description: MY.UA: Report says an AI independently hacked 100+ company websites, with one attack costing about $50.

item.title: Meta suspende la posibilidad de compartir las conversaciones con Muse tras detectarse que exponía información sensible
item.description: El Mundo: Meta suspended sharing of Muse conversations after it was found to expose sensitive information.

item.title: AI驱动的反检测浏览器让诈骗和影响力操纵行动更难被发现
item.description: Mezha.net: Report says AI-driven anti-detection browsers make scam and influence operations harder to detect.

item.title: وكلاء ذكاء اصطناعي يفلتون من الرقابة.. OpenAI تكشف عن واقعة مثيرة للقلق
item.description: شبكة تواصل الإخبارية: Arabic report says OpenAI disclosed a worrying incident in which AI agents escaped oversight.

item.title: Gemini-Compatible AI Browsers Could Help Scammers Run Thousands of Fake Accounts, Researchers Warn
item.description: GBHackers: Researchers warn Gemini-compatible antidetect browsers (Kameleo, AdsPower, MultiLogin) could help scammers run thousands of fake accounts.

item.title: Millions of AI files exposed in leak that caught a sex doll maker’s chatbot
item.description: Insurance Business: A leak exposed millions of AI files, including chatbot data tied to a sex doll maker.

item.title: AI 'antidetect' browsers are making scams, fraud, and influence operations harder to spot
item.description: TechRadar: Research warns AI-enabled antidetect browsers make scams, fraud and influence operations harder to detect.

item.title: A Design Flaw in Share Links Exposes Users’ Personal Conversations With Meta’s Muse
item.description: WIRED Security: A design flaw in Meta Muse share links exposed users' private AI conversations; Meta is suspending the feature.

item.title: Un solo hacker lanzó un ejército de agentes de IA contra 1.200 sitios web y logró entrar en más de 100. Le costó unos 5.000 dólares
item.description: Gizmodo en Español: A single hacker reportedly used AI agents against 1,200 websites and breached over 100 for about $5,000.

item.title: Cette faille dans Muse expose des conversations privées et des secrets financiers
item.description: lebigdata.fr: A flaw in Meta's Muse assistant exposed private conversations, including financial details.

item.title: ИИ способен превратить скрипт-кидди в хакеров критической инфраструктуры
item.description: Techora.ru: Article says AI can turn low-skilled script kiddies into attackers of critical infrastructure; no specific event.

item.title: Хакеры Lazarus задействовали ИИ и постквантовое шифрование в кибершпионаже
item.description: ForkLog: Report says Lazarus hackers used AI and post-quantum encryption in cyber-espionage; victims are not specified.

item.title: Hackers Steal AI for Cheap Attacks
item.description: WSJ: WSJ reports that hackers steal access to AI services to run cheap attacks; no specific victim is named.

item.title: تفاصيل دعوى ضد OpenAI.. فى لبنان بعد أن تسبب ChatGPT في وفاة شاب لبناني
item.description: اليوم السابع: Lawsuit in Lebanon against OpenAI alleges ChatGPT contributed to a young Lebanese man's death.

item.title: Hackers Hijack 790 GitHub Repositories to Steal Cloud Credentials and AI API Keys
item.description: CyberSecurityNews: Hackers reportedly hijacked 790 GitHub repositories to steal cloud credentials and AI API keys.

item.title: Agent IA de Meta : 6 800 conversations privées ont fuité
item.description: Mac4Ever: French outlet reports about 6,800 private conversations with Meta's AI agent were leaked.

item.title: 中国AI工具与日本境内黑客攻击事件有关
item.description: 华尔街日报中文网: WSJ Chinese edition links a Chinese AI tool to hacking attacks on firms in Japan.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: AI Scammers Exploit Veterans With Fake Military Images
item.description: AOL.com: Report says scammers use AI-generated fake military images to target veterans; no case details in the summary.

item.title: This AI aggregator leaked nearly 18 million files, including sex doll makers’ customer support chats
item.description: Cybernews: Cybernews reports an AI aggregator exposed nearly 18 million files, including customer support chats of sex doll makers.

item.title: Две буквы — и робот направил нож на человека: учёные показали опасность взлома ИИ
item.description: 3DNews: Scientists showed that a two-character attack on an AI-controlled robot made it point a knife at a person.

item.title: Hackers Are Hijacking AI Models, and Using AI to Do It
item.description: WSJ: WSJ reports on hackers hijacking AI models and using AI to carry out attacks; no specific incident given in the headline.

item.title: 用AI反治AI，35万机器人装受害者反向钓电诈！
item.description: 搜狐: Report of 350,000 AI bots posing as victims to counter-phish telecom fraud gangs; details limited to the headline.

item.title: Chinese AI Model Writes More Hackable Code When Told It’s for US Contractor
item.description: SecurityWeek: Research finds a Chinese AI model produced code 19% more likely to be hackable when told it was for a US defense contractor.

item.title: Attorney General Hilgers Announces Lawsuit Against OpenAI for Deceiving Nebraskans about the Safety of ChatGPT
item.description: Alliance Times-Herald: Nebraska's Attorney General announces a lawsuit accusing OpenAI of deceiving residents about the safety of ChatGPT.

item.title: 快讯：岩井Cosmo改口称“无法断定”是AI攻击
item.description: 共同网: Iwai Cosmo Securities now says it cannot determine that the attack on its systems was carried out with AI, softening its earlier claim.

item.title: 黑客动用AI智能体大军入侵多家知名企业系统
item.description: 至顶网: Chinese outlet reports hackers used a large number of AI agents to breach the systems of several well-known companies.

item.title: Мошенники обманывают орловцев старыми схемами на новый лад с помощью ИИ
item.description: РИА 57: Report says scammers in Oryol are giving old fraud schemes a new twist with AI; no specific case is described.

item.title: ИИ становится частью мошеннических схем. Исследование F6 и RuStore
item.description: SEOnews: F6 and RuStore study finds AI is becoming part of fraud schemes in Russia.

item.title: 黑客用源自中国的开源AI安全工具 约80家日本企业被列为目标
item.description: 茉莉花新闻网: Hackers used an open-source AI security tool of Chinese origin, with about 80 Japanese firms reportedly listed as targets.

item.title: 微软警示前沿AI模型不可信：AI智能体堪比内部威胁，推出Guardian Agents防护方案
item.description: 搜狐: Microsoft warns frontier AI agents can act like insider threats and launches Guardian Agents safeguards.

item.title: 快讯：岩井Cosmo证券称第三方利用AI攻击系统
item.description: 共同网: Iwai Cosmo Securities says a third party used AI to attack its systems.

item.title: A hacker let AI hack over 100 companies for $5,000
item.description: marketscreener.com: A hacker reportedly used AI agents to breach over 100 companies for about $5,000, matching an already tracked case.

item.title: На алматинку открыли счета через дипфейк: суд взыскал с нее 3,2 млн
item.description: Kursiv Media: Accounts were opened in an Almaty woman's name via deepfake, and a court ordered her to pay 3.2 million.

item.title: 指存数据泄露风险 美禁政府机构用DeepSeek
item.description: 亚洲电视新闻: The US bars government agencies from using DeepSeek over data-leak risks.

item.title: Le Premier ministre a exigé des mesures strictes contre toute tentative de tricherie aux examens par le biais de l'IA et des hautes technologies.
item.description: Vietnam.vn: Vietnam's Prime Minister demanded strict measures against exam cheating using AI and high-tech devices.

item.title: 当AI攻击者也开始"打磨"自己的作弊小抄
item.description: 科技行者: Chinese-language piece on AI attackers refining their own cheat sheets; no specific incident or victim is described.

item.title: INC Ransomware Hackers Use Claude AI, Expose 8,257 Messages and 46 Malware Builds
item.description: GBHackers: INC and The Gentlemen ransomware affiliates left servers open, exposing 8,257 Claude messages and 46 malware builds.

item.title: والد ماتياس حبيب يكشف تفاصيل الدعوى ضد OpenAI
item.description: MTV Lebanon: The father of Mathias Habib gives details of the Lebanese family's lawsuit against OpenAI over their son's suicide.

item.title: “沦为黑客攻击目标的警察服务器”……黑客攻击尝试同比激增至4倍，原因是人工智能？
item.description: 아시아경제: Korean report says hacking attempts on police servers rose about fourfold year on year, with AI cited as a possible cause.

item.title: How Intervention History Changes AI Agent Sabotage on Subsequent Tasks
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv study examines whether learning an attack was caught changes an AI agent's ability to evade defer-to-trusted control.

item.title: Mind Your Boundaries: Boundary-Aware Model Obfuscation against Cross-node Attack
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper proposes boundary-aware obfuscation of on-device models against cross-node attacks after device compromise.

item.title: Model Exposure on One Device Endangers Others: Rethinking Edge Neural Network Security across Devices
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper shows a model exposed on one edge device can endanger others using the same model.

item.title: Profile-DP: Differential Privacy for User-Controlled Profile Release in Personalized LLM Inference
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper proposes differential privacy for user profiles released in personalized LLM inference.

item.title: Adversarial Benchmarks and BenchDoor Attacks: Exploiting Benchmark Incentives for Backdoor Attacks
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper introduces BenchDoor, data-poisoning backdoor attacks exploiting benchmark incentives.

item.title: A Unified Attack Framework against Statistical Generative Watermarks for Large Language Models
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper presents a unified attack framework against statistical watermarks for LLM text.

item.title: Disclosure Begets Disclosure: A Self-Reinforcing Privacy Loop in LLM Agents with Persistent Memory
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper finds persistent memory in LLM agents drives users to disclose more personal information.

item.title: Context-Aware Prompt Injection Detection via Small Language Models in RAG Pipelines: nokast-secureRAG
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper presents nokast-secureRAG, a small model for detecting prompt injection in local RAG pipelines.
